prompt: Which of these live in the AF Library? Select all that apply.
explanation: The Library holds element templates, event frame templates, categories, enumeration sets and tables. Event frames themselves are in the Event Frames section.

prompt: True or false: AF Libraries automatically include the UOM database.
explanation: True. An AF team developer confirmed that libraries automatically include the UOM database.

prompt: Which export option also exports the templates, tables and UOMs needed to rebuild a structure?
explanation: "Include All Referenced Objects" exports what is needed to rebuild the structure on another server.

prompt: Match each AF SDK XML flag to its family.
explanation: PISystem.ExportXml(obj, PIExportMode.NoUniqueID | PIExportMode.Flat, ...) and PISystem.ImportXml(db, PIImportMode.AutoCheckIn, ...) are the SDK calls.

prompt: Which AF 2018 SP2 feature helps here?
scenario: A team promotes a template library with 40 analyses and 10 notification rules from test to production. They want to review everything before anything starts running.

options.text: Import analyses and notification rules in a disabled state
Use PI Builder to import notification rules

explanation: From AF 2018 SP2, analyses and notification rules can be imported disabled for review. PI Builder cannot manage notification rules.

prompt: Order a safe test-to-production promotion of an AF model.

items.text: Export from test with Include All Referenced Objects
Import into production with analyses and rules disabled
Review and test the imported analyses
Enable the analyses and notification rules

explanation: Export with referenced objects so dependencies travel, import disabled (AF 2018 SP2), review, enable, then commit.
verifyNote: This sequence combines sourced features into a suggested process; it is not a documented AVEVA procedure.

prompt: How does the AF SDK getting-started sample deliver its practice database?

options.text: As an XML file you import in PSE
It downloads from PI Web API

explanation: The sample ships its database as AF Database - Green Power Company.xml, imported in PSE.

prompt: Which statement about AFExport/AFImport command-line utilities is supported by readable sources in this course?

options.text: Their existence and options were not confirmed; check the AF documentation
They are the only supported way to export

explanation: AFExport.exe and AFImport.exe appear only in training knowledge, not in a readable source, so they are flagged for verification. PSE and the SDK export paths are sourced.
verifyNote: AFExport/AFImport utilities are unverified training knowledge; confirm in %PIHOME%\AF and the docs.
